name: PayPerScreen
description: Pay-per-call sanctions, crypto-wallet, email, and IP risk screening, priced in USDC and authenticated entirely by x402 micropayments. No account, no API key, no subscription.
apiBaseUrlNote: All skill paths below are relative to this base (the API subdomain), not to payperscreen.com itself.

skills.name: Sanctions name screening
skills.description: Fuzzy name match against the sanctions lists loaded (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK); each response lists exactly which were checked. Each hit includes the record ID, programmes, aliases, and a field-by-field comparison of the date of birth, nationality and type you send.

skills.name: Field comparison
skills.description: Field-by-field comparison for the top /screen hit. Now included in every /screen hit's comparison; kept for existing integrations.

skills.name: Crypto wallet address screening
skills.description: Exact-match lookup against OFAC's sanctioned digital-currency addresses, Tether's USDT freeze list on Tron read on-chain (frozenByIssuer), and a curated list of addresses tied to major hacks (hackFunds). Each reported separately.

address.description: Wallet address on any supported chain

skills.name: Email trust check
skills.description: Deterministic composite of mail-server validity, disposable-domain detection, domain age, mailbox verification, blocklist status, MX provider, and typo-squat detection. Returns riskLevel (low/medium/high) and redFlag.

skills.name: IP risk check (beta)
skills.description: Known-high-risk-IP check against the Spamhaus ZEN blocklist and the Tor exit-node list. IPv4 only. Returns riskLevel (low/medium/high) and redFlag.

ip.description: A public IPv4 address to check
